business_problem: As Brown Health expanded its regional footprint, clinicians faced rising patient demand, financial pressures, labor shortages, burnout, and heavy documentation demands that made it increasingly difficult to dedicate time for patient-centered care.
solution_summary: Brown Health used Dragon Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft Copilot Studio to reduce clinician documentation burden and extend AI into day-to-day care-delivery operations. After acquisitions and a physician-practice merger expanded the health system, clinicians were under pressure to see more patients, document more complex encounters, and keep pace with enterprise standardization across core platforms. Dragon Copilot records visits and drafts clinical documentation in parallel with the encounter, Microsoft 365 Copilot supports follow-on knowledge work, and Copilot Studio powers agents for ED guidance, policy lookup, patient access, translation, scheduling, and other operational workflows. Brown Health tied these tools into its broader digital transformation so staff could capture information once, route requests faster, and spend more time on direct patient care while scaling AI use across the organization.
